elena (partnerships): Heads-up: ACME Cloud Marketplace asked for our release window tonight 01:00-03:00 UTC. We need a confirmed driver/CUDA/ROCm pin + rollback plan before we greenlight marketplace publish. @kai @sam :eyes:

kai (partner-ops): ACME's release requires a pinned stack. They want the marketplace image to reference a single driver/cuda tuple. Note: we observed a 12.3 CUDA regression on A100 related to quant kernels last week. Suggest pin to a known-good set until we verify. :rotating_light:

sam (eng-runtime): Can we list the exact pinned versions we intend to support? I can wire a canary route (1% traffic, eu-west-1) + automatic fallback to older runtime variant if we see regressions. Also will need a rollout RFC for the marketplace image tag change.

mike (eng-ml): FYI regression detail: llamaX quant path hits a kernel OOM on CUDA 12.3 in our perf lab. Short log: `RuntimeError: CUDA error: out of memory at aten::empty` on call to quant_k_cache. Reproducible on latest nightly with model X.

sam (eng-runtime): Proposed pinned set (working):
```
NVIDIA driver: 535.86
CUDA: 12.2
ROCm: 5.7
Runtime image tag: rdx-runtime-2026-03-22-pinned
```

kai (partner-ops): ACME accepted 535.86/CUDA12.2/ROCm5.7 as an interim. They'll hold their marketplace publish until we confirm smoke in canary. Partner ops will run the validation matrix against their SI integrator images in ~2 hours. If regression persists we open hotfix branch `driver-535-pin-hotfix` and coordinate vendor driver rollback.

jen (pm): For customer comms: if we go with the pin, we need to sync release notes with ACME and keep the public announcement embargoed until 24h after canary is green. Also add a note about possible delayed features tied to CUDA12.3.

sam (eng-runtime): I'll add automatic fallback policy to the runtime config: route->canary; if tail latency > 300ms or error rate > 0.5% for 30s, route traffic to `runtime-legacy-driver-535` and trigger an alert. Config snippet: `fallback: {error_threshold: 0.005, tail_latency_ms: 300, window_s: 30}`

deploy-bot: Scheduled release window created for 4501234567 (01:00-03:00 UTC). Canary job queued: marketplace-canary-acme-01.

elena (partnerships): Action items: 1) partner-ops run SI matrix and post results (kai) 2) runtime team enable canary + fallback (sam) 3) ML confirm model smoke - especially quant paths (mike) 4) PM hold announcement + sync with ACME (jen). I'll update ACME SOW and note the pin. :memo:

sam (eng-runtime): Will post smoke results here once canary completes (should be < 90m after start). I'll also attach the canary dashboard link and the autoscaler logs if any spike.

kai (partner-ops): Running validation now. Quick note: ACME asked if we can also provide a rollback script they can invoke. I'll prepare `marketplace_rollback.sh` that swaps image tags + invalidates canary.

jen (pm): Confirmed — hold on public comms until I get the 24h post-canary thumbs-up from ACME. If we need a hotfix, we'll coordinate a joint announcement with partner comms.

elena (partnerships): Great. Ping me if ACME asks to surface kernel-level details; we'll keep that between vendor ops and eng until we have a fix. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
